main_text.p: districtus[?] tantùm mentionem fece-rit; Cl. Walæus id extendit ad Magi-stratus supremos majorum etiam-territoriorum ac regionum; item quod Beza dixerat de Consistoriis, ipse extendit ad conventus Ecclesia-sticos etiam majores imò supremos, seu Synodos: Eadem ratio, inquit, locum debet habere etiam respectu Ma-gistratuum supremorum, qui majoribus territoriis & regionibus imperant, nec non respectu maximorum seu supremorum conventuum Ecclesiasticorum, qui in illis quoq; regionibus sunt. Nam etiamsi co-gnitio & judicium talium conventuum majorum minus suspectum esse debeat, quàm minorum congregationum; nihilo-minus tamen similes errores ab iis com-mitti possunt, quemadmodum experien-tia Synodorü & Conciliorum monstravit, quorum injustis actionibus possunt ac de-bent resistere supremi Magistratus ex obligatione officii sui. Idem vir Clarissi-mus p. 141. citat pro suæ sententiæ declaratione Robertum Burhillum
Q[?] marks the opening of the quaestio title in the running head; the first word of the page is cut at the top edge and only partly legible.

page.notes: The first word of the page (districtus) is partly obscured at the top edge, so the reading is doubtful. The running head Q symbol is an abbreviation mark for Quaestio and is uncertain. The italic and roman boundaries in lines 8 to 24 are approximate, since some words are set in bold italic. "quoq;" is printed with a mark over the q that may be a different abbreviation. The Google watermark at bottom right is excluded.
